panels.title: $ticker stocks: equity and debt, at book and market ($currency)
panels.description: Book: total assets, liabilities, stockholders' equity and long-term debt from the balance sheet. Market: market cap each trading day (the close times the latest cover page's shares). Market cap against stockholders' equity is the market's valuation of the equity against the accounts'.

panels.title: $ticker flows: income and returns to shareholders ($currency, $period)
$ticker valuation: market cap and book value ($currency)

targets.query: SELECT "value" FROM "reported_item_v15" WHERE "ticker" =~ /^$ticker$/ AND "item" = 'StockholdersEquity' AND "period" = 'pit' AND "currency" =~ /^$currency$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Market cap each trading day: the close times the shares on the latest cover page (Tiingo prices). Book value is stockholders' equity as reported. Where market cap runs above book, the market pays a premium over the accounts.

panels.title: $ticker per share: price and book value ($currency)

targets.query: SELECT "value" FROM "reported_item_v15" WHERE "ticker" =~ /^$ticker$/ AND "item" = 'BookValuePerShare' AND "period" = 'pit' AND "currency" =~ /^$currency$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: The daily close against book value per share (equity over the cover page's shares). Price-to-book, on the right axis, is market cap over equity.
